product.description: Monoprice™ 4K Braided High Speed HDMI® Cables feature the next generation of active HDMI cable technology. It delivers 10.2 Gbps bandwidth and supports Ultra HD HDMI video transmissions with video resolutions up to 4K@30Hz with YCbCr 4:2:0 chroma sampling. These cables now support the latest in high resolution performance and HDCP™ 2.2 compliance.This cable supports the following general features: Supports 4K@30Hz: This cable supports HDMI® video resolutions up to 4K@30Hz, with YCbCr 4:2:0 chroma samplingUp to 10.2 Gbps Bandwidth: This cable delivers up to 10.2 Gbps bandwidth, which allows it to support all of the features in the latest HDMI® specificationIt supports the following HDMI features: HDCP™ 2.2 Compliant: High‑bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP) is a copy prevention technology that's been used on HDMI® connections for over ten years.
